content.title: About
content.content: Egg, whole, baked, no salt (NS) is a whole chicken egg cooked in the oven without added salt. Baking retains most nutrients while giving the egg a firmer texture compared with boiled eggs.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Baked eggs are often used in salads and sandwiches as a convenient protein source.
During baking, the egg white coagulates at a lower temperature than the yolk, leaving the yolk creamy.
Salt‑free eggs are suitable for low‑sodium diets.
Properly cooled baked eggs can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.
Heat treatment destroys most pathogens, including Salmonella.

items.title: High‑quality protein
items.content: One large egg provides about 6 g of complete protein essential for muscle growth and repair.

items.title: Source of vitamin D
items.content: The yolk contains vitamin D, which supports bone health and immune function.

items.title: Contains choline
items.content: Choline is important for brain function and fat metabolism.

items.title: Low sodium
items.content: No added salt makes this product suitable for people monitoring sodium intake.

items.title: Eye health support
items.content: Lutein and zeaxanthin in the yolk help protect eyes from age‑related degeneration.

items.title: Egg allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to egg proteins, which can be severe.

items.title: Salmonella risk
items.content: Undercooked eggs may harbor Salmonella; ensure the yolk is fully set.

items.title: Cholesterol content
items.content: The yolk contains cholesterol; people with high cholesterol should consume in moderation.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: A large egg contains about 70 kcal; consider total calories in a balanced diet.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Baked eggs can be eaten plain, sliced into salads, added to sandwiches, or used as a topping for vegetable dishes. They store well in the fridge and reheat quickly in the microwave.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Cool baked eggs to room temperature, then keep them in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days. Reheat to an internal temperature of at least 74 °C before consumption.
